authorization.authorized_action: run exactly three independently recreated VRTSIM passthrough repetitions with the frozen ten-second stabilization and thirty-second observation windows, then restore the original AWGN compose state
authorization.authorization_basis: Phase 3C7 protocol commit c56338e, verified fresh-node rebuild result commit a77f772, and the user's active reservation and request to continue

execution.independence_unit: forced recreation of both VRTSIM containers before each repetition

window_and_acceptance_rules.startup_failure_markers: recorded as diagnostics through the end of stabilization and never hidden
window_and_acceptance_rules.post_stabilization_failure_source: append-only log suffix captured after ten continuously healthy stabilization seconds

stopping_rules: stop before deployment on any profile revision, runner checksum, image identity, compose checksum or healthy-baseline mismatch
stop if either container exits, restarts or the UE is unattached at any stabilization or observation poll
stop during observation on any frozen PBCH, PUSCH, random-access, RLC maximum-retransmission, unhandled-RLF, actual-RLF or lost-sync marker
stop if either Docker log is not append-only relative to its frozen observation prefix
stop and roll back after any failed repetition without tuning or retrying a different condition
do not mount or evaluate CIRDB data
do not calculate MMD, compare absolute RSRP, infer parameters or run ABC

branch_after_execution.all_three_pass: accept the passthrough transport safety gate and freeze a separate CIRDB replay amendment using the same observation-window contract
branch_after_execution.any_failure: keep CIRDB closed and return to offline VRTSIM transport or scheduling diagnosis
